name: Fashion Menu
description: Full-screen list of large outlined names with counters and subtitles. Hovering a row shows a tilting image card that follows the cursor, with a custom two-ring cursor and grain overlay.
contents: Vertical list of outlined uppercase names with numbered counters
Subtitle line per item that reveals character by character on hover
behavior: Names rise in with a staggered rotated entrance
Hover image card follows the mouse with eased tilt, skew and brightness based on mouse speed
Card pops in with an elastic rotation on enter and out on leave
Small cursor tracks instantly, large ring trails with a lag, shown only on fine pointers
Under 54em subtitles are hidden and sizes shrink
editableByProps: Item names, subtitles and hover images
Font family, text sizes, spacing, image card size
Cursor lag and stroke width, grain overlay on or off

needsCodeEdit.change: Change tilt, skew or brightness intensity of the image card

fixed: Root is a fixed full-viewport scroll container and sets html and body to overflow hidden while mounted, so it takes over page scrolling and should be the only content on the page
Loads the Google Font named by fontFamily through a link tag added to document head
Custom cursor follows the mouse and only appears on fine pointers
Image cards are hover-driven and do not appear on touch devices
